part5.q: Our company plans to ------- additional staff before the busy season begins.
part5.ex: plans to 後接原形動詞 hire；hired/hiring/hires 語法錯誤。

part5.q: Many companies rely on professional staging services to ------- their properties to potential tenants.
part5.ex: to 後接原形動詞 showcase 合文法，其他選項皆不合。

part5.q: The new marketing campaign was designed to ------- brand awareness among younger consumers.
part5.ex: to 後需原形動詞 boost，boosting/booster/boosted 都不能作為此句動詞使用。

part5.ex: 雖然各部門課程內容不同，but 皆要一個月內完成，Although 正確；Despite 易誤選但後需名詞。

part5.q: Donors who ------- more than $500 will receive special recognition at the charity fundraiser banquet.
part5.ex: 這裡是限定詞子句，who 後面要用原形動詞 (動詞一致)，故選 contribute。contributed 和 contributing 都語法不合。

part5.ex: unless 表示“除非...否則”，符合句意。if 和 because 會改變句子意思，as 用於表示原因而非條件。

part5.ex: sign a lease for [period of time] 是正確搭配。on, of, with 都不正確。

part5.ex: last month 表示過去時間，需用過去式 released。has released 是現在完成，與線索詞不符。

part5.q: Property owners should ensure that all leasing agreements are ------- reviewed before signing.
part5.ex: reviewed 需要副詞修飾，thoroughly 為副詞。thorough (形容詞)、through (介系詞)、thoroughness (名詞) 均不適用。

part5.q: Anyone ------- is interested in volunteering at the charity event can sign up at the information desk.
part5.ex: who 可用來指人當主詞，符合句意。whose 為所有格，whom 作受詞，which 指物。

part5.q: The property manager is responsible for ------- tenant complaints and coordinating necessary repairs.
part5.ex: for + 動名詞，故用handling；handle為原形，handled為過去分詞，handles為現在式。

part5.q: A detailed ------- will be sent after the product launch to summarize the feedback from attendees.
part5.ex: 需要一個名詞做主詞，故選 report。reporting 是動名詞，reported 和 reporter 都不是正確答案。

Thank you for participating in our survey about your recent experience with FastShip Logistics. Below are summary results from 250 respondents:

- Of those with delays, 48% indicated they were not notified in advance.

part5.ex: how well（如何…好）正確；what well, when well, which well 都不合語法。

part5.q: The museum's new exhibition ------- attracted over 10,000 visitors in its first week.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 successfully，修飾動詞 attracted 需要副詞。successful 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞。

part5.q: Volunteers are required to register ------- advance of the community event.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 in advance，因為 in advance 是固定搭配。by advance 並不成立。

part5.q: Please submit your application ------- the deadline to ensure consideration.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 before the deadline，表示必須在截止日前。after 意義不符。

part5.q: The bank's new online system allows ------- to check their balances easily.
part5.ex: 正確答案是 customers，此處指能夠使用網路系統的人。it 不是指人，語意不對。

part5.q: Building maintenance reports ------- to be filled out by supervisors every Friday.
part5.ex: are required to be filled out 是被動語態，主詞 reports 是複數。require 缺少被動。

part5.q: ------- his repeated complaints, the customer received only a standard response.
part5.ex: Despite 表示「儘管」，符合語境。Because 意為原因，語意不符。

part5.q: Museum staff members work together ------- ensure the safety of all visitors.
part5.ex: to ensure 表示目的。by ensure 語法錯誤。

part5.q: The volunteer program coordinator will ------- a training session next Monday.
part5.ex: will 之後需用動詞原形 conduct。conducts 不能和 will 搭配。

part5.q: Safety procedures ------- posted throughout the factory for workers' reference.
part5.ex: procedures 是複數，搭配 are。is 為單數。

part5.q: The ------- of the complaint took several days due to the need for further information.
part5.ex: processing of the complaint（申訴的處理）語意完整。process 缺少表動作。

part5.q: We have received frequent ------- about the condition of the restrooms in our building.
part5.ex: complaints（複數）符合上下文。complain 為動詞，語法不通。

part5.q: The ------- of safety regulations is strictly enforced in the factory.
part5.ex: compliance with 是固定用法，意為遵守。comply 是動詞，語法不符。

part5.q: ------- all machines have been inspected, production can resume.
part5.ex: Once 表示「一旦」，語意正確。Unless 表示「除非」，語意不符。

part5.q: The museum offers a ------- of services for both local and international visitors.
part5.ex: a variety of 是固定搭配。variable 和 varied 不能與 of 搭配表示多樣性。

part5.q: If you ------- any issues with your bank account, please contact customer service immediately.
part5.ex: 條件句 if you 後需用原形動詞 experience。experiencing 語法錯誤。

part5.q: Building maintenance should be scheduled ------- prevent unexpected equipment failures.
part5.ex: regularly 修飾動詞 scheduled，表示頻率。regular 為形容詞，語法不合。

part5.q: A formal response was given, ------- the customer was not satisfied with the solution.
part5.ex: yet 表示轉折「然而」。so 表示因果，語意不符。

part5.q: The bank's foreign currency services are highly ------- among international travelers.
part5.ex: highly regarded 為固定搭配，意為「受好評」。regard 作為動詞語法不符。

part5.q: Our building maintenance team always ------- to resolve issues as quickly as possible.
part5.ex: team（集合名詞，作單數處理），需用 strives。strive 用於複數主詞。

part5.q: The museum curators are busy ------- the new exhibition before the opening ceremony next Saturday.
part5.ex: preparing 是正確動詞形式；prepare（動詞原形）和 preparation（名詞）語法錯誤。

part5.q: According to the airline's updated policy, passengers ------- more than two checked bags must pay an additional fee.
part5.ex: with 用於表示攜帶物品；by、of、in 與此用法不符。

part5.q: The community event was postponed ------- bad weather last weekend.
part5.ex: due to 接名詞片語表原因；because 需接句子。

part5.q: After attending the training workshop, employees showed greater ------- in using the new software.
part5.ex: confidence（名詞）正確；confident（形容詞）和 confidently（副詞）語法不合。

part5.q: Shipping delays ------- by severe weather have affected deliveries nationwide.
part5.ex: caused by 用來修飾 delays，表示被動關係。causing（主動）語意錯誤。

part5.q: All visitors ------- from the main entrance must show their tickets to security staff.
part5.ex: entering 作為分詞修飾 visitors；entered（過去式）語意不符。

part5.q: She is ------- for the position because of her extensive experience and leadership skills.
part5.ex: qualified（形容詞）形容人；qualify（動詞原形）不符文法。

part5.q: ------- the heavy rain, the outdoor performances continued as scheduled.
part5.ex: Despite 用於讓步語意；Because（因為）語意與句子不符。

part5.q: The airline will not accept any luggage ------- weighs more than 32 kilograms.
part5.ex: that 正確用於限定性關係子句指事物；who 只能指人。

part5.q: Many customers ------- their packages would be delivered on time, but shipping delays occurred.
part5.ex: assumed（過去式）符合過去時語境；assume（現在式）時態錯誤。

part5.q: Museum staff recommend ------- cell phones on silent mode while viewing the exhibits.
part5.ex: recommend 後面用動名詞（keeping）；to keep 是常見誤選但錯誤。

part5.q: The workshop will cover ------- topics as team-building, time management, and conflict resolution.
part5.ex: such...as... 片語用於舉例；like 不能和 as 並用。

part5.q: There has been a significant ------- in shipment arrivals this month, according to logistics data.
part5.ex: increase（名詞）正確；increasing（分詞）不合此句語法。

part5.q: ------- the candidates performed well, only three were selected for the final interview.
part5.ex: Although（雖然）正確表讓步轉折；Because（因為）不符語意。

part5.q: The training workshop aims to ------- employees with the skills necessary for customer service excellence.
part5.ex: aims to equip（使具備）是正確搭配；equipped（形容詞）、equipment（名詞）不合文法。

part5.q: All packages ------- be inspected by customs before being delivered to their final destination.
part5.ex: must be inspected（必須檢查）正確；could/would 表示可能性或假設不合語境。

part5.q: Staff should notify management ------- any problems occur during the community event.
part5.ex: if（如果）用於條件句；while（當...時）語意不符。

part5.q: Applicants are required to submit their résumés ------- consideration by the hiring committee.
part5.ex: for consideration（提出審核）是常見搭配；at、to、of 不正確。

part5.q: The shipping company apologized for the ------- in the delivery of several orders last week.
part5.ex: for the delay（延遲）用名詞；delayed（形容詞）與語法不符。

part5.q: The annual charity fundraiser ------- a record amount of donations this year, surpassing all previous events.
part5.ex: 正確答案是received，因為描述的是過去的年度募款活動。最容易混淆的是receives，但這裡時間點已經在去年。

part5.q: All volunteers are required to attend a ------- session before beginning their assignments at the museum.
part5.ex: training是修飾session的名詞，指訓練課程。trained是形容詞但這裡需要名詞。

part5.q: Ms. Cho was pleased to see ------- of her staff nominated for the Employee of the Year award.
part5.ex: several用於可數名詞，指多位員工。much和little用於不可數名詞。

part5.q: The catering service will deliver the food ------- the museum event starts at 6:30 p.m.
part5.ex: before表示在活動開始前送餐，文意正確。unless表示除非，與文意不符。

part5.q: Applicants ------- speak a second language will have a definite advantage in the interview process.
part5.ex: who用於形容人，指那些會第二語言的申請者。which和what不適用於人。

part5.q: The volunteer ------- impressed the museum staff with her enthusiasm and commitment.
part5.ex: consistently修飾動詞impressed，指她持續展現熱忱。consistent是形容詞，不能修飾動詞。

part5.q: We need to finalize the catering order ------- tomorrow in order to confirm with the restaurant.
part5.ex: by有截止的意思，表示必須在明天之前完成。for則有目的或為了的意思，不合適。

part5.q: ------- the exhibition was delayed, visitors still expressed strong interest in the new artwork.
part5.ex: Although表示讓步轉折，符合句意。Because表示原因，前後語意不通。

part5.q: The manager explained that all employees would be considered ------- for the monthly recognition award.
part5.ex: eligible是形容詞，接be動詞最恰當。eligible for是多餘，文法錯誤。

part5.q: Mr. Samson has already ------- to assist with organizing the charity fundraiser this weekend.
part5.ex: has already後應接過去分詞agreed。agree是原型，不吻合現在完成式。

part5.q: The museum director asked the team to ------- creative ideas for the upcoming exhibition.
part5.ex: to後需接原形動詞suggest。suggested是過去式，此處不合文法。

part5.q: Many volunteers expressed their ------- with the new program during last Friday’s meeting.
part5.ex: expressed需接名詞satisfaction。satisfying和satisfied是形容詞。

part5.q: Candidates should bring their updated résumés ------- with official identification to the interview.
part5.ex: along with表示和…一起。beside是「在…旁邊」，不合文意。

part5.q: The awards ceremony will begin soon, so please be ------- to take your seats.
part5.ex: be後需接形容詞，prepared為正確答案。prepare是動詞，文法不符。

part5.q: We can provide vegetarian options, ------- you let us know in advance.
part5.ex: provided that表示條件（如果）。otherwise意指否則，語意不合。

part5.q: During the job interview, candidates may be asked about their previous ------- experience.
part5.ex: 修飾經驗（experience）應用形容詞professional。profession是名詞，意思不同。

part5.q: The volunteer program ------- many new members last quarter thanks to improved outreach efforts.
part5.ex: 描述上季已經發生的事情，用過去式attracted。attracts是現在式，不合時間點。

part5.q: The museum has a ------- of rare artifacts that are not usually displayed to the public.
part5.ex: collection是名詞，指「收藏品」。collect是動詞。

part5.q: All volunteers should dress appropriately for the event ------- maintain a professional appearance.
part5.ex: to maintain表示目的是保持專業形象。for maintain文法錯誤。

part5.q: The marketing team will attend the ------- trade show to network with industry professionals.
part5.ex: 答案 annual 為形容詞，修飾 trade show。annually 是副詞，不能修飾名詞。

part5.q: If the budget proposal ------- by next Friday, the project launch will be postponed.
part5.ex: 被動語態 is not approved 符合句型；does not approve 主動語態不合文意。

part5.q: Many business travelers prefer to stay at hotels that ------- complimentary breakfast and Wi-Fi.
part5.ex: that 引導的關係子句主詞為 hotels，需用 offer。offers 主詞單數錯誤。

part5.q: Shipping delays are ------- affecting importers due to increased customs inspections.
part5.ex: adversely 為副詞，修飾動詞 affecting。adverse 形容詞，無法修飾動詞。

part5.q: We are planning to ------- the trade exhibition to attract more international buyers.
part5.ex: expand 為動詞，動詞不定詞需用原形。expansion 為名詞，不適合。

part5.q: Despite the unexpected weather, the ------- of travelers arriving on time remained high.
part5.ex: percentage 才能當名詞，指比率；percent 是百分比符號用法，不可當主詞。

part5.q: Hotel guests must present valid photo identification ------- check-in.
part5.ex: upon check-in 是固定用語，意為“在辦理入住時”；其他選項皆不通。

part5.q: The budget review meeting was delayed ------- the financial officer was unavailable.
part5.ex: because 用於說明原因，although 會導致語意矛盾。

part5.q: The product samples ------- to all trade show participants last Monday.
part5.ex: 複數主詞 samples 用 were distributed（被動過去式）；distributed 缺乏助動詞。

part5.q: Business travelers are encouraged to book flights early, ------- they may have fewer options.
part5.ex: otherwise 表示“否則”，符合句意。besides 跟 besides, furthermore 表附加。

part5.q: The company’s ------- to resolve shipping issues quickly was appreciated by its customers.
part5.ex: effort 表“努力”，fit context；effect 為“效果”，語意不符。

part5.q: The conference organizer asked ------- to confirm their attendance by email.
part5.ex: context 需用複數 participants 指“與會者們”；participation 為“參與”，語法錯誤。

part5.q: We are unable to process your request ------- your booking reference number is missing.
part5.ex: because 說明原因，whereas 表對比語意不通。

part5.q: There were shipping delays ------- the port workers’ strike.
part5.ex: due to + 名詞，用於表原因；as 需接子句，不可搭配名詞。

part5.q: Mr. Lin, ------- leads the export department, will attend the trade show in Singapore.
part5.ex: 先行詞為人，主格子句需用 who；whom 用於受格。

part5.q: The hotel offers a variety of ------- for business travelers, including meeting rooms and laundry service.
part5.ex: amenities 指飯店設施，特別指便利設施；priorities（優先事項）語意錯誤。

part5.q: All equipment must be ------- packed before shipping to prevent damage during transit.
part5.ex: securely 為副詞，修飾動詞 packed。secure 為形容詞，不符文法。

part5.q: The CEO will travel to London ------- attend a major trade conference.
part5.ex: to attend 為不定詞，表目的；for attend 錯誤。

part5.q: The hotel manager confirmed that all ------- had been processed for guests attending the annual conference.
part5.ex: 正確答案為reservations，因為文中需用名詞。最易混淆選項reserved為形容詞/動詞過去分詞，語意不符。

part5.q: The health clinic ------- its new patient portal last week to improve appointment scheduling.
part5.ex: 本句描述過去發生的動作，應用過去式launched。launch和launches為現在式，will launch為未來式，皆不符語境。

part5.q: Employees who exceed ------- expectations may be nominated for the quarterly award.
part5.ex: 此處需用名詞performance表現，修飾expectations。perform為動詞，performing為動名詞/現在分詞，performed為過去分詞，皆不對。

part5.q: The trade show was cancelled ------- a severe weather warning was issued for the area.
part5.ex: because說明原因，語意通順。although表示讓步，語意不合上下文。

part5.q: Quarterly sales figures ------- announced at the staff meeting next Monday.
part5.ex: 由於句中的“next Monday”表示未來，且需被動語態，故選will be。are和were時態不對，have文法錯誤。

part5.q: To ------- one of our furnished apartments, please contact the leasing office during business hours.

qs.ex: 空格需要一個動詞原形以配合祈使句，故選 greet；greeting 是名詞，greets/greeted 時態不符。

o: In addition, offer visitors suggestions for nearby restaurants if asked.
Sculptures are often made from various materials.
Artists spent many years developing their unique styles.

so that 呼應目的『使參觀更有收穫』；despite、otherwise、unless 語意連接不對。

Company Newsletter Announcement

Every year, we recognize outstanding employees who have demonstrated exceptional performance and dedication. We invite all staff members to submit nominations for the 2024 Employee of the Year Awards.

To nominate a colleague, please fill out the online form by August 15. All {1} will be reviewed by the selection committee, and finalists will be announced on September 1. {2} Only employees who have worked at the company for at least one year are eligible for nomination.

Winners will receive a special trophy and a generous bonus at the annual company gala. We {3} encourage supervisors and team leaders to participate, but anyone can nominate a coworker. With your help, we can celebrate those who have truly made a difference.

Don’t miss the chance to {4} your appreciation for your teammates’ hard work and achievements!

qs.ex: 正確答案是A 'nominations'（提名），因為前面是 'All ______ will be reviewed'，需用名詞。B和C為動詞或動名詞不符文法，D 'nominators'（提名人）意思不正確。

o: Please remember to submit your nomination on time.
Recently, several new employees have joined the team.
The company was founded over 30 years ago.
Lunch will be provided at the event.
qs.ex: 正確答案是A，提醒符合 nomination 流程的內容。B、C、D 都偏離上下文主題，與提名資格無關。
正確答案是A 'especially'（特別地），強調鼓勵主管參與。B和C語意不符，D 'finally' 也無因果連結。
正確答案是A 'show your appreciation'（表達感謝）為常見搭配。B、C、D與 appreciation 不搭配。

To: All Staff
From: Office Administrator
Subject: Important Catering Order Update

Dear Team,

This is to notify everyone about changes to our catering order policy, which will {1} starting next Monday. Previously, orders were accepted up to noon on the day of your event. {2} , all requests must now be submitted at least 48 hours in advance to ensure timely preparation and delivery. {3} , exceptions cannot be made without approval from the department manager. {4}

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
Cynthia Lee
Office Administrator

qs.ex: 正確答案是 A（take effect），用於描述規定正式開始實施；B 和 D 文法錯誤，C 為過去式，與時間“next Monday”不符。
正確答案是 A（However），文意為“然而”，用來對比原本的規定與新規定；B 代表因果關係，C 舉例，D 表示否則，皆不合文意。
B（Additionally）用來補充說明新的政策內容。A 表結果，C 表示否則，D 表具體說明，都不符補充語氣。

o: If you have already submitted a request this week, you do not need to resubmit it.
All employees are encouraged to try the new catering menu items next month.
The catering provider has increased its delivery charges for all departments.
You may contact the building manager for details about parking arrangements.
qs.ex: A 適合放在政策說明後，補充已經遞交申請的人不用再提交。B、C 和 D 與訂餐政策和上下文無直接關聯。

The Downtown Museum is pleased to announce the opening of its latest exhibition, "Colors of Change." {1} features works from both established and emerging artists, each exploring the shifting landscape of contemporary society through vivid hues and bold techniques. {2} the significance of art in capturing moments of transformation, the exhibit invites viewers to reflect on their own experiences.

For more information, visit the museum's official website or contact the visitor services desk by phone or email.

qs.ex: It 正確地代表『Colors of Change』展覽，是單數名詞，符合主詞；They 對應複數，與前文不符。
Recognizing 作為現在分詞，正確用於引導原因，說明整個展覽的主題。Recognize 為動詞原形，不適合此句文法結構。

o: Guests are encouraged to arrive 15 minutes before their scheduled time.
All workshops have already been fully booked for the summer.
The museum will be closed on Mondays during the exhibit.
Parking is not available at the museum.
qs.ex: 此句提醒訪客提前到達，與預約和安全措施連貫。其他選項和現有內容無直接關聯，會打斷前後語意。

o: Additionally, masks are required for entry.
However, the exhibit is free for children under 12.
For this reason, many people prefer guided tours.
Otherwise, visitors may forget the event.
qs.ex: Additionally, masks are required for entry，接續前句關於安全要求。其他選項無法合理承接上文，語意跳接。
